caseName: Maehr v. Comm'r of Internal Revenue
caseNameFull: Jeffrey Thomas MAEHR v. COMMISSIONER OF INTERNAL REVENUE.

opinions.text: Motion of petitioner for leave to proceed in forma pauperis denied. Petitioner allowed *571until November 19, 2012, within which to pay the docketing fee required by Rule 38(a) and to submit a petition in compliance with Rule 33.1 of the Rules of this Court.
